Satisfying Local Rice Joint - True Vietnamese Flavor.
Dec 2024 • Couples
Dropped by for lunch today and was really impressed with this no-frills rice spot. The food are just right - hot and perfectly cooked. Loved the variety of dishes to choose from - everything from crunchy rice with braised fish sauce to steamed pork and stir-fried pickled vegetables with tomato.
The prices are reasonable - around $4.50-6 for a filling portion. The staff moves quickly even during the lunch rush, and while the space is basic, it's kept clean with good ventilation.
Only minor drawback is it gets pretty packed during peak hours, so you might need to wait for a table. But honestly, at these prices, I can't complain!
Pro tip: Come before noon to beat the crowds and get the best selection of dishes. The food here has that bold Vietnamese flavor - if you're not used to fish sauce, you might want to ask them to go easy on the seasoning!
Will definitely be back. This place reminds me of the kind of authentic local spots that make Vietnamese food culture so special.
Note: This is based on my lunch visit, prices may vary.
